content.value_statement: Azure AI projects span many services and SDK patterns. This skill gives focused guidance for search, speech, documents, translation, vision, and authentication.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Azure AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, and Document Intelligence.
Points users to Azure MCP tools for search and speech workflows.
Provides SDK quick references for Python, TypeScript, .NET, and Java.
Summarizes authentication guidance for DefaultAzureCredential and ManagedIdentityCredential.
Links to Microsoft Learn documentation for deeper Azure AI service details.
limitations: Does not include runnable scripts or automated Azure provisioning.
Requires an Azure account, configured services, and appropriate permissions.
Does not replace complete Microsoft SDK documentation.
Some advanced patterns are delegated to related plugin skills if installed.

use_cases.title: Plan AI Search Integration
use_cases.description: Choose full-text, vector, hybrid, or semantic search patterns for an application.

use_cases.title: Build Speech Workflows
use_cases.description: Use transcription and text-to-speech guidance for audio features and support workflows.

use_cases.title: Review Azure AI Authentication
use_cases.description: Compare local and production credential patterns before deploying Azure AI services.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to add an AI feature to my Azure app. Help me choose the right Azure AI service and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Query a Search Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me query an Azure AI Search index. Include when to use full-text, vector, hybrid, and semantic search.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a retrieval augmented generation pattern using Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search. Include indexing, query flow, and authentication guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Auth
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Azure AI authentication plan for production. Compare managed identity, workload identity, and local development credentials.

output_examples.input: I need searchable product documents with natural language questions.
output_examples.output: Use Azure AI Search with hybrid search and semantic ranking. Index documents in batches, align vector dimensions with embeddings, and use managed identity in production.

output_examples.input: I need to transcribe long support calls.
output_examples.output: Use batch transcription for long files stored in blob storage. Enable diarization, request timestamps, specify the language, and close sessions after processing.

output_examples.input: I need to extract invoice fields from uploaded PDFs.
output_examples.output: Use Document Intelligence with a prebuilt invoice model first. Check field confidence, poll long-running operations, and move to a custom model only when needed.

best_practices: Use managed identity and RBAC in production. Use DefaultAzureCredential only for local development.
Prefer Azure MCP tools for supported search and speech tasks.
Check SDK quick references before writing service-specific code.
anti_patterns: Using DefaultAzureCredential as the production credential strategy.
Hardcoding Azure service keys, endpoints, or connection strings.
Treating quick references as complete documentation for every API option.

faq.question: Does this skill run Azure commands by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and references. Tool use depends on the host environment and enabled Azure MCP tools.

faq.question: Which Azure AI services does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence, Vision, Translation, and Content Safety references.

faq.question: Can it help with Azure AI Search?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains full-text, vector, hybrid, semantic, and indexing patterns for Azure AI Search.

faq.question: Does it include authentication guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains local development credentials and production managed identity guidance.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: What should I configure before use?
faq.answer: Prepare Azure resources, permissions, endpoints, and any required MCP tools before asking for service-specific help.
